title: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AGI arrives in two years, how do we balance innovation with responsibility?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models lack reasoning and common sense—AGI would require breakthroughs in neural architecture and reasoning.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Unchecked AGI could erode labor rights, privacy, and democratic institutions if not governed transparently.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are building alignment frameworks and open-sourcing safety tools to ensure responsible development.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With global collaboration, AGI could solve climate change and cure diseases by accelerating scientific discovery.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The next two years will define whether AGI becomes a tool for progress or a risk to humanity.

video_cue: A montage of scientists, engineers, and ethicists working together in a high-tech lab.
